metadata.name: Masochist Class Tree
metadata.description: Single continuous web. The Path of Suffering runs up the centre and is what fills Fervour from health lost. Flesh Craver upper-left, Blood Tithe upper-right, Flagellant lower-left, Low Life lower-right. Keystones sit at the far end of each limb and need full investment in their parent. The four vow capstones are the 25/50/100/200 point tiers and stand apart from the web.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Health you lose generates Fervour: 1 per 1% of maximum health lost to damage, and 1 per 1% of maximum health spent as an ability cost. While you have this, healing removes Fervour at the same rate, 1 per 1% of maximum health restored, so your health regeneration is what empties it rather than a timer.

data.name: Pain Tolerance
data.description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point.

data.name: Willing Flesh
data.description: +1% increased Health Regeneration per point for every 10% of your maximum health missing.

data.name: Gathered Pain
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for every full 25 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Brutal Determination
data.description: +1% Life Leech for every 2 points. The Masochist has no Life Leech of its own, so this is what the tree's other Life Leech nodes increase.

data.name: Echoes of Agony
data.description: Damage taken from damage over time effects is reduced by 2% per point.

data.name: Open Wounds
data.description: +5% increased Fervour gained from health lost to damage per point.

data.name: Deeper Cuts
data.description: Your skills also cost 1% of your current health for every 2 points, in addition to any other cost. This cost generates Fervour like any other.

data.name: Scar Tissue
data.description: +5 maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Hardened Nerves
data.description: +4 Crowd Control Resistance per point.

data.name: Retributive Instinct
data.description: +2% Retaliation per point.

data.name: Communion of Pain
data.description: While you have 100 or more Fervour, you deal 20% more damage.

data.name: Sanguine Ledger
data.description: Healing never takes your Fervour below 50.

data.name: Reciprocity
data.description: Your Retaliation damage is increased by 1% for each point of Fervour you currently hold.

data.name: Provoked
data.description: +2% increased melee damage per point for 4 seconds after you are hit.

data.name: Bulk
data.description: +1% increased Maximum Health per point. At 6 points: +1% Life Leech.

data.name: Reprisal
data.description: Your Retaliation is increased by 1% per point for each enemy within 4 metres of you.

data.name: Vicious Onslaught
data.description: +1% increased Attack Damage per point for every 5% of your maximum health that is missing.

data.name: Blood Offering
data.description: Taking damage grants a stack of Bloodlust for 5 seconds, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased melee damage per point.

data.name: Thirst for Pain
data.description: +1% increased Attack Speed per point for each stack of Bloodlust you have.

data.name: Battle-Scarred
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, +1% Life Leech for every 2 points.

data.name: Undying Hunger
data.description: +5% increased Life Leech per point.

data.name: Ravenous
data.description: +1% increased melee damage per point for every 2% of Life Leech you have.

data.name: Gorge
data.description: You gain 1 Fervour whenever an enemy dies within 10 metres of you, per point.

data.name: Unflinching
data.description: While you have 50 or more Fervour, +3% increased Attack Speed per point.

data.name: Carnage
data.description: Killing an enemy while above 75 Fervour grants a stack of Carnage for 8 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Each stack gives 3% more melee damage.

data.name: Wounds That Feed
data.description: Healing from Life Leech does not remove Fervour.

data.name: Flesh Craver
data.description: 30% more Fervour gained from health lost to damage.

data.name: Stigmata
data.description: When you set an enemy alight, you are set alight as well for 4 seconds, taking 1% of your maximum health per second. +3% increased damage over time per point.

data.name: Lingering Hurt
data.description: +4% increased damage over time duration per point.

data.name: Penitent
data.description: +2% increased Health Regeneration per point for each debuff on you.

data.name: Endurance in Suffering
data.description: +2% increased damage per point for each debuff on you.

data.name: Wound Channeling
data.description: You deal 3% increased damage per point to enemies carrying a debuff you also carry.

data.name: Symphony of Pain
data.description: Debuffs on you last 5% longer per point, and the damage they deal you is reduced by 2% per point.

data.name: Contagious Torment
data.description: When a debuff on you deals damage, enemies within 6 metres have a 5% chance per point to receive a random debuff you carry.

data.name: Empathic Link
data.description: When an enemy dies, its debuffs have a 10% chance per point to pass to a random enemy within 6 metres.

data.name: Beacon of Despair
data.description: You radiate an aura that applies a random debuff to enemies within 6 metres every 3 seconds, lasting 4% longer per point. You deal 1% increased damage per point to enemies for each debuff they carry. Your auras reserve 2% reduced mana per point.

data.name: Shared Agony
data.description: +5% increased Fervour gained from health lost to damage over time per point.

data.name: Ceaseless
data.description: While you have 50 or more Fervour, +3% increased damage over time per point.

data.name: Vessel of Plagues
data.description: Debuffs on you last 50% longer, and each debuff on you counts twice for everything that counts the debuffs on you.

data.name: Doctrine of Pain
data.description: You deal 4% more damage for each unique debuff on you.

data.name: Flagellant
data.description: Every debuff on you grants 5 Fervour per second for as long as it lasts.

data.name: Quickened
data.description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point for every 10% of your maximum health missing.

data.name: Razor's Edge
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, +2% increased damage per point.

data.name: Defiance
data.description: +1% Retaliation per point for every 25% of your maximum health missing.

data.name: Living on the Edge
data.description: While at or below 35% health, +2% increased damage per point.

data.name: Last Stand
data.description: While you are at or below 35% health, +1% Damage Reduction per point.

data.name: The Catalyst
data.description: While you are at or below 35% health, your skills have a 4% chance per point not to go on cooldown.

data.name: Desperate Measures
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, +3% increased Attack Speed per point.

data.name: The Breaking Point
data.description: Dropping below 50% health converts all damage you take into Bleeding over 5 seconds. The conversion lasts 3 seconds, and 1 second longer for every 2 points, and cannot happen more than once every 10 seconds.

data.name: Unstable Aura
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, you release a nova every 3 seconds dealing 10% of your weapon damage per point to enemies within 6 metres.

data.name: Bloodletting
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, you gain 1 Fervour per second for every 2 points.

data.name: Threadbare
data.description: While you are at or below 50% health, Fervour removed by your health regeneration is reduced by 10% per point.

data.name: The Edge
data.description: While at or below 20% health you take 25% less damage and your Fervour does not decrease.

data.name: Point of No Return
data.description: You cannot be healed above 50% of your maximum health, but you deal 25% more damage.

data.name: Low Life
data.description: While at or below 35% health you gain 10 Fervour per second.

data.name: The First Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Water to Blood
options.description: You no longer have a mana pool. All maximum mana is converted into added maximum health, and every ability costs health instead of mana.

options.name: Reprisal Wave
options.description: Your retaliation damage strikes every enemy within 4 metres, not only the one that hit you, and 1 metre further for every 25 Fervour you hold.

options.name: Stigmatic
options.description: Each debuff on you grants 4% increased damage and 4% increased health regeneration.

data.name: The Second Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Rock Bottom
options.description: A health cost can never reduce you below 1 health; anything you cannot pay becomes health debt instead. Dropping below 20% health clears all outstanding debt and grants 50 Fervour, no more than once every 30 seconds.

options.name: Feeding Wound
options.description: Your life leech applies to your retaliation damage as well as to your attacks, and your Life Leech is increased by 1% for every 2 Fervour you hold.

options.name: Ceaseless Penance
options.description: Debuffs on you no longer expire while you are above 50% health.

data.name: The Third Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Deficit
options.description: Your damage is increased by 1% for every 2% of your maximum health you are missing or owe.

options.name: Glutton
options.description: You deal 1% more damage for every 10 Fervour you hold.

options.name: Doctrine Made Flesh
options.description: Each debuff on you grants 3% more damage and reduces the damage that debuff deals to you by 10%.

data.name: The Final Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: The Last Drop
options.description: While below 20% health your skills cost no health, and every skill you cast grants 10 Fervour.

options.name: Carnivore
options.description: Every hit you take grants a stack of Carnage. Carnage has no maximum, each stack grants 2% more damage, and each stack lasts 1 second longer for every 10 Fervour you hold.

options.name: Vessel Unbroken
options.description: Debuffs on you deal no damage at all, and each one grants 5% more damage and 5 Fervour per second.

data.name: Blood Coin
data.description: Each skill you cast grants 1 Fervour for every 3 points.

data.name: Blood Price
data.description: +5% increased Fervour gained from health spent as an ability cost per point.

data.name: Ready Blood
data.description: +2% increased maximum Health per point.

data.name: Deferred Payment
data.description: 10% per point of the health a skill costs is not taken when the skill is used. It is taken 3 seconds later.

data.name: Compound Interest
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for every 5% of your maximum health you currently owe.

data.name: Rolling Debt
data.description: Paying a health cost while one is still owed extends the delay on what is owed by 1 second for every 2 points, to a maximum of 3 seconds.

data.name: The Reckoning
data.description: Health costs are never taken. They accumulate as a debt. You deal 1% more damage for every 2% of your maximum health that you owe, and the debt is cleared by killing an enemy and never by time. If your debt ever exceeds your current health you begin to bleed out, losing health until you kill something or die of it.

data.name: Blood Rush
data.description: +2% increased damage per point for 2 seconds after you pay a health cost.

data.name: Sanguine Momentum
data.description: Each health cost paid within 3 seconds of the last grants a stack, up to 5 stacks. Each stack gives +1% increased attack speed per point.

data.name: Grand Tithe
data.description: A skill whose health cost is above 2% of your maximum health deals 4% increased damage per point.

data.name: Exsanguinate
data.description: A skill that costs health deals 30% more damage.

data.name: Staunch
data.description: The Fervour removed by your own health regeneration is reduced by 5% per point.

data.name: Deep Reserves
data.description: While you have 50 or more Fervour, +3% increased damage per point.

data.name: Blood Tithe
data.description: 30% more Fervour gained from health spent as an ability cost.
